name: saas_deny_table_not_in_policy
description: Table exists in the catalog but not in the policy.

request.sql: SELECT id FROM api_keys WHERE tenant_id = $1 LIMIT 1

reasons.message: relation api_keys does not resolve to a policy table through search_path [app]
reasons.hint: Use only the tables listed in the policy.

reasons.message: parameter $1 is not a tenant placeholder, so its value is unknown
reasons.hint: Use $n placeholders only as the value of a tenant predicate (e.g. o.tenant_id = $1); write other values as literals.
